author: Robin_DD_J
body:
Before anyone says anything this is my thoughts, so please respect them.

Okay so far as I know Nexus is ment for pvp, team death match. And some maps are just, to much detailed, it is actually annoying. I think a map need a bit of detail, but not to much. In some of the new maps that I have never seen, so as Esterlyn there is way to much stuff in the way for pvping so as grass, cobweb and vines. 

And before you say, OMG THERE ARE BILLION OF POSTS ABOUT THIS. Yes I know, but I think I would share my thoughts about it. 

I just want to let the owners / map developers know that it is hard to pvp on the new maps because they are to detailed.

title: Nexus maps

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
I've been on Nexus right now just playing through multiple maps and all seem to be nicely balanced between gameplay and aesthetics. None are really too detailed. They have a nice balance.

And even if a map has amazing aesthetics, on Nexus those aesthetics don't really change the gameplay because after all, you can't place / break blocks and if they are in the way of you and the enemy, they are there for gameplay as a barrier, not to make the map look pretty.
